## About
Alvarado Tires is a tire and auto service shop on Firestone Blvd in Los Angeles. We sell and install tires and wheels, fix flats, and handle alignments, brakes, TPMS sensors and engine diagnostics, whether you drive a passenger car, truck, mini-van or SUV.
Our customers come from around the neighborhood and from Long Beach and Inglewood. Reviewers tell us they like that we explain their options, show them the wear on their old tires, and don't push work they don't need.
Stop by during business hours, or call or text us with questions.

## Services
- Tire installation and repair: Tire purchase and installation, tire repair, rotation and computerized wheel balancing.
- Wheel alignment: We adjust your wheels so they sit parallel to each other and square to the road.
- Brake repair: Brake inspections, rotor replacement, front disc brake repair and parking brake adjustment.
- TPMS sensors: We fix tire pressure monitoring sensors so your dash light tells you the truth.
- Engine diagnostics: Engine diagnostics and tune-ups when something doesn't feel right.
- Wheel purchase and installation: We sell and install wheels.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Whether you drive a passenger car, medium sized truck, mini-van or SUV, we can help, across a variety of makes and models.

A: We're in Los Angeles on Firestone Blvd and serve customers from Los Angeles, Long Beach, Inglewood and nearby.

Q: Can I text you instead of calling?
